entries.title: Welcome to Global Cataclysm: 1972
paragraphs: Welcome to the game! This is the public playtest server for Global Cataclysm:1972. Please have fun and enjoy the game. Try different scenarios. Take on some bots. Challenge your friends. Challenge your rivals.
Join us on the public playtest Discord server. Let us know what you think of the game. Compare notes and chat with other players.

During this playtest period, we will be limiting the number of user accounts. But we don’t want to lock out people who are truly interested in playing. If your account is locked because there are too many users, come introduce yourself on the Discord, and we’ll see if we can help.
